summary: Cameco Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 4, 2026, announcing the voluntary filing of a National Instrument 43-101 technical report for its McArthur River uranium operation. The company explicitly stated the report was not prompted by any change to mineral reserves or resources constituting a material change. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine Canadian continuous-disclosure equivalent of a technical/operations update; there is no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle to monitor.
